title: Digital consciousness needs a present physical invariant

statements.text: The burden falls on proponents of digital consciousness to identify an observer-independent present physical invariant shared across materially different implementations. Until one is specified, computation is an abstract description of what different systems are taken to be doing, not a state-sufficient physical basis for consciousness.

sources.quote: The burden therefore falls on proponents of digital consciousness to identify an observer-independent present physical invariant shared across these materially and geometrically disparate implementations.
